summary: Alliance hybrid: Blessing of Freedom (learned at 18) makes paladins strong flag-carrier support against snares, backed by seal-and-judgement burst and off-heals like Lay on Hands. Value swings on composition.
factionNotes: Paladins are Alliance-only in Classic Era (Human, Dwarf). Human weapon-skill racials and Dwarf Stoneform (removes bleed, poison, and disease) shape matchups. Verify current racial and blessing specifics against the Wowhead Paladin guide at authoring.
